title: rosa canina subsp. pouzinii
intro: Rosa canina subsp. pouzinii, commonly known as the Alpenrose, is a subspecies of the wild rose plant native to the European Alps. This plant is valued for its edible hips, which are rich in nutrients and offer a range of health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-boosting properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina subsp. pouzinii include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce menstrual cramps, and promote wound healing due to its bioactive constituents, which include vitamins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Bioactive constituents of this plant include ascorbic acid, flavonoids such as quercetin and kaempferol, and phenolic acids like salicylic acid, contributing to its potential health benefits.
